summary_ja: 届出を怠った場合や承認基準を満たさなくなった場合に、金融庁長官が期待エクスポージャー方式の承認を取り消せることを定める。
summary_en: The FSA may revoke approval of the expected exposure method if notification is neglected or the approval standards are no longer met.
paragraphs: The Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may revoke the approval under Article 49, paragraph (1) where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach that has received approval for the use of the expected exposure method has failed to make the notification under paragraph (1), item (ii) of the preceding Article, or falls under item (iii) of that paragraph.
